title: The paper trail
body: Describe what documents you needed to collect — proof of accommodation, financial means, insurance, enrollment or employment letters, and so on. Mention anything that was harder to obtain than expected.

title: At the embassy or consulate
body: Walk through what the appointment itself was like — booking it, wait times, what the officer asked, how long it took, and how you felt walking out.

title: Processing time, and how I stayed sane
body: Talk about how many weeks it took, any status checks you did, and advice for others waiting on their own decision.
callout: Reality check: Processing times vary case by case — plan your travel dates with buffer room, never book non-refundable flights before approval.
